shots.narration_line: Most drone demos look the same.
shots.visual_prompt: Opening on the same high-tech pirate command ship at golden hour. The original straw-hat pirate host stands at the bow while a compact autonomous drone lifts from a concealed deck dock. A blue holographic route line arcs over the ocean toward distant industrial islands.
shots.camera: slow push in from ocean level to the bow, cinematic spray, stable hero framing

shots.narration_line: A drone takes off, a dashboard lights up, and everyone calls it autonomy.
shots.visual_prompt: Inside the same ship's command cabin, brass-and-wood table covered by a cyan holographic drone dashboard. The host taps a floating takeoff icon; a miniature route map and fleet status appear without clutter.
shots.camera: controlled dolly across the table into a close-up of the holographic mission map

shots.narration_line: But the hard part is not the takeoff.
shots.visual_prompt: Presenter avatar shot based on the original pirate host concept, direct to camera, dark teal virtual command-room background, subtle drone route overlays, serious confident expression.
shots.camera: static medium close-up, clean key light, slight animated background parallax

shots.narration_line: The hard part is getting physical AI to survive the real world.
shots.visual_prompt: The holographic ocean route transforms into a rugged industrial map: dusty mine, windy port, solar farm, rail corridor, and public safety command center. Drone docks keep operating under weather and operational pressure.
shots.camera: smooth top-down map transition into an aerial reveal across connected infrastructure sites

shots.visual_prompt: Premium title-card motion inside the same ship command room: readable text 'NestGen 26' and 'Physical AI from pilot to production' appears as cyan holographic lettering above a brass compass and drone route map.
shots.camera: slow cinematic orbit around the holographic title, clean end hold

shots.narration_line: It is where operators compare the playbooks that usually stay inside the boardroom: procurement, BVLOS approvals, hardware integration, ROI, and what broke while scaling.
shots.visual_prompt: The pirate host studies a glowing captain's chart where boardroom documents become operational playbooks: procurement checklist, BVLOS approval path, hardware compatibility nodes, ROI graph, fleet scaling map. Serious enterprise tone, no clutter.
shots.camera: slow push across the chart to the host's focused face, shallow depth of field

shots.narration_line: FlytBase already has the proof points: leak detection compressed from days to under 90 minutes, solar inspection scaled from 150 megawatts to 1 gigawatt, security costs cut by 60 percent.
shots.visual_prompt: Three cinematic proof-point vignettes on the same holographic sea map: mining leak alert timer compressing to under 90 minutes, solar farm scale expanding from 150 MW to 1 GW, security patrol cost indicator dropping 60 percent. Real infrastructure behind each data point.
shots.camera: macro movement through the holographic data points, then a wide operational reveal

shots.narration_line: The future of drones is not a drone. It is a reliable, approved, repeatable system that works when nobody is watching.
shots.visual_prompt: Final hero shot on the same command ship at blue hour. Multiple autonomous drones return to hidden docks across the deck while the holographic map confirms missions complete across mines, ports, solar, rail, utilities, and public safety. The original pirate host looks toward the horizon.
shots.camera: slow pullback from the host to the full ship and connected industrial horizon, confident ending hold

shots.narration_line: That is the story I want to help FlytBase tell.
shots.visual_prompt: Presenter avatar shot based on the original pirate host concept, direct to camera, warm confident final line, subtle NestGen 26 holographic mark behind the shoulder, same teal command-room background.
shots.camera: static medium close-up, clean key light, direct eye contact
